**Impact:** Medium

#### Azure Machine Learning Prompt Flow is being retired  
  
Prompt Flow is being deprecated across Azure Machine Learning and Foundry. This includes all components—DAG flows, Flex flows, SDKs, and UI integrations. Applicaitons currently using Prompt Flow need to be migrated to supported frameworks like the Microsoft Agent Framework along with the Foundry SDK  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid potential disruptions  

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [Azure updates](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates/?id=502936)
